exports.name: tender_plot_master
exports.purpose: One current, source-backed context row per database-vacant plot; used by the tender workflow dropdown and safe plot-context prefill.

exports.name: tender_plot_area_history
exports.purpose: All plot/let-out area and consumed-FSI records for evidence review.

exports.name: tender_tenancy_reference
exports.purpose: Historic and active tenancy, existing approval-date, rent, lease, and security-deposit references.

exports.name: tender_application_reference
exports.purpose: Application-property records connected to the exported vacant-plot tenancy references.

exports.name: tender_rate_reference
exports.purpose: Raw public-schema zone, service-charge, and interest-rate records. These are references only, not automatic tender approvals.

exports.name: tender_source_coverage
exports.purpose: Counts that expose which tender inputs are actually available in the public database.
